section.title: Product tasks
section.subtitle: Plan the work, assign ownership, and keep every detail with the product.
section.open: {count, plural, =0 {No open tasks} =1 {1 open task} other {# open tasks}}
section.emptyBody: Add the first task to turn this product's next step into owned, dated work.

form.title: Task
form.notesPlaceholder: Add context, links, or acceptance notes…
form.attachmentsHint: Markdown, PDF, Office documents, or images. Up to 8 files, 25 MB each.
form.productHint: Leave as General for team work that belongs to no single product.
form.productLockedHint: A task stays with the product it was filed under.
form.productBlockedHint: Subtasks follow their parent, and a task in a release must leave it first.
form.phaseHint: Which delivery phase this work serves.
form.phaseNeedsProductHint: Pick a product first — phases belong to a product.

task.deleteConfirm: Delete this task and all its subtasks and attachments?

logo.label: Product logo
logo.hint: Square PNG, JPG, WebP, or SVG works best. Maximum 10 MB.

media.selected: {count, plural, =1 {1 image selected} other {# images selected}}
media.selectedFiles: {count, plural, =1 {1 file selected} other {# files selected}}

all.title: All tasks
all.subtitle: One operational view of every task: general team work and everything filed under a product.
all.searchPlaceholder: Search tasks, products, notes, or people…
all.emptyBody: Adjust the filters, or add a task — general, or filed under a product.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid: Check the task fields and try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.notFound: The task could not be found.
errors.imageType: Only image files can be uploaded.
errors.imageSize: Each image must be smaller than 10 MB.
errors.tooManyImages: You can upload up to 8 images at a time.
errors.uploadFailed: The image upload failed. Please try again.
errors.fileType: That file type cannot be attached.
errors.fileSize: Each file must be smaller than 25 MB.
errors.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to 8 files at a time.
errors.productLocked: A task cannot be moved between products.
errors.hasSubtasks: Remove the subtasks before moving this task to a product.

errors.parentMismatch: A subtask must sit under the same product as its parent.

attachments.previewFailed: The file could not be read here. Open it directly instead.

completion.prompt: Describe what you did to complete this task
completion.placeholder: What changed, how you did it, anything the next person needs to know…
completion.hint: This is kept on the task and shown to anyone who opens it later. Watchers get the first part in their notification.
completion.noNoteBody: This task was completed without a note.
